name: @botflow/backend
description: BotFlow Ads API + Telegram Bot + Delivery Engine

scripts.start: prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma && node dist/index.js
scripts.worker: prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma && node dist/workers/index.js
scripts.// start:api: Aliases so `npm run start:api` works whichever package.json npm reads. Render runs the start command from the service root, but if the working directory is this package instead, the root's script is invisible and npm reports `Missing script: start:api` on a repo that plainly has it.
scripts.// migrate-on-boot: Every start path applies pending migrations first: `start` and `start:worker` are what Render reaches through the root aliases, `start:api` and `worker` are the same thing when npm is run from this package instead. The comment above `start:api` explains why both spellings exist at all. Miss one and a schema change ships code that queries columns the database does not have. Nothing in the deploy pipeline used to run them, so every schema change shipped code that queried columns the database did not have yet — which surfaced as a bare "Database error" on whatever screen touched the new column. `migrate deploy` is idempotent and takes a Postgres advisory lock, so the API and the worker racing at boot is safe. The prisma CLI is a devDependency and the Render build installs with --include=dev; if that ever changes, move prisma to dependencies or migrations will not run.
scripts.start:api: prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma && node dist/index.js
scripts.start:worker: prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma && node dist/workers/index.js
scripts.// test: Integration suite: needs a live PostgreSQL (Redis recommended). globalSetup creates + migrates the test DB. See README "Tests".
scripts.pretest:
node -e "console.error('
[botflow] Backend tests are INTEGRATION tests: they need a live PostgreSQL (and Redis) and apply real Prisma migrations.
[botflow]   start local infra : npm run infra:up   (docker compose)
[botflow]   point elsewhere   : TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/botflow_ads_test npm test
[botflow]   DB-free unit tests: npm run test:unit  (run from the repo root)
')"
scripts.// test:unit: DB-free unit tests (tests/unit/**). No PostgreSQL or Redis required.
